snippet.title: Worm Capitalist | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5073430/Worm_Capitalist/

Worm Capitalist is an incremental game about raising hungry worms, watching them devour everything pixel by pixel, and turning their poop into profit.

💩 Turn Poop into Profit
💲 Upgrade and Expand your Colony
🪱 Build a Worm Empire
